content:
Kaspr is a B2B sales intelligence and LinkedIn data extraction platform. It is made to enable sales teams, recruiters, and founders to find verified business contact details directly from LinkedIn workflows. Cognism, the expert platform in browser-based led enrichment, owns Kasper. 

The platform can be used directly through a lightweight Chrome extension that integrates directly with LinkedIn, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Recruiter Lite. Eventually, it streamlines the prospecting workflow.

How does Kaspr work?

Kasper works using a browser-integrated enrichment framework. It connects LinkedIn profiles to verified B2B contact databases in real time. Its operational workflows include:

  • LinkedIn Profile Detection 
  • Database Cross-Referencing 
  • Real-Time Contact Verification 
  • CRM and Workflow Synchronization 

Kaspr uses a Chrome-based automation to verify data sources and enrichment workflows. It enables companies to:

  • Extract direct phone numbers and business email addresses from LinkedIn.
  • Automate lead enrichment across bulk prospect lists
  • Decrease manual copy-pasting and prospect research
  • Sync enriched contacts directly into CRM systems

Core capabilities powering Kaspr

Contact Data Extraction

Kaspr provides verified mobile numbers, direct dials, and business email addresses.

Linkedin and Sales Navigator Integration

Its native brower extension supports different Linkedin environments 

Bulk Lead Enrichment

The platform uses CSV uploads and search-result extraction for high-volume prospecting 

CRM synchronization

Kasper directly integrates into different CRMs. Some of them include Hubspot SalesForce, Pipedrive and more.

Sales Workflow Automation

It automates lead routing, tagging, and triggering outreach.

What makes Kaspr stand out?

  • Lightweight Chrome Extension- Kasper is designed as a lightweight Chrome extension. It helps for frictionless LinkedIn prospecting.
  • Cognism expertise- It is supported by Cognism's popular, enterprise-grade European B2B Infrastructure. 
  • Visual Previews- The platform gives immediate visual previews of the contact data before clients spend their credits. 
  • Self-service pricing- Kaspr has transparent self-service pricing. It eliminates the use of mandatory enterprise contracts.

Key Services Offered by Kaspr

  • Direct Mobile Number Discovery- Kapr gives immediate access to personal mobile lines and direct corporate dials. 
  • Business Email Verification- It does real-time validation of professional email addresses during delivery.
  • LinkedIn Profile Enrichment- The platform has a simple one-click extraction of contact and firmographic data
  • Sales Navigator Bulk Extraction- Kaspr enriches data across the entire LinkedIn search results page. 
  • CSV Batch Processing- It works on bulk enrichment of uploaded lists of Linkedin profiles URLs
  • Outreach Workflow Integration- The platform makes native connections with cold outreach tools such as Lemlist.

Advanced Capabilities

  • Automated Sales Workflows- Kaspr works on consistent monitoring and enrichment of Sales Navigator results 
  • Dynamic Lead Filtering- It enables users to prioritize leads based on phone and email availability and custom conditions. 
  • CRM Property Mapping- The platform works on granular routing and data synchronization controls 
  • Account Safety Features- Kaspr has a special “Stealth mode” overlay option to reduce LinkedIn active visibility

Who should work with Kaspr?

  • Sales Representatives and SDR teams- SDRs running outbound prospecting through LinkedIn.
  • Startups and SMB Teams- SMB searching for affordable, self-service lead generation tools 
  • Talent Acquisition Teams- Recruiters looking for passive candidates outside the LinkedIn InMail limitation

Best Fit Industries

  • B2B Sales Organizations
  • SaaS and Technology 
  • Recruiting 
  • Professional Services
  • Marketing and Advertising Agencies

Key Use Cases

  • High-Velocity Cold Calling- Kaspr directly extracts mobile numbers for outbound workflows. 
  • Cold Email List Building- It gives verified email lists for custom outreach campaigns. 
  • Sales Navigator Bulk Prospecting- The platform enriches large LinkedIn search cohorts simultaneously. 
  • CRM Data Enrichment- Kaspr updates and syncs prospects' databases automatically 
  • Recruiting Outreach- It contacts passive candidates outside LinkedIn messaging systems. 
  • Automated Lead Routing- The platform sends enriched leads directly into CRM and outreach workflows

Pros

  • Flexible monthly pricing for SMBs
  • Simple setup with minimal onboarding formalities 
  • Strong European data coverage through Cognism
  • Unlimited B2B email lookups on selected plans 
  • Seamless integration with LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, and CRM i

Considerations 

  • Needs a business email and Linkedin account to register
  • Heavy Linkedin use might trigger platform monitoring systems 
  • Entry level plans give limited phone number credits 
  • May lag North American data coverage

Top Alternatives to Consider

  • Lusha- Exceptional North American contact data 
  • Surfe- Impressive CRM focused Linkedin sync and contact management 
  • Apollo.io- Ideal all-in-one prospecting enrichment platform 

Conclusion

Kaspr is one of the best, streamlined, and browser-first sales intelligence platforms. It is made particularly for fast-paced outbound sales and recruiting workflows. The platform emphasises on frictionless Linkedin enrichment and direct contact extraction.Is your organization looking for a fast, affordable and easy-to-use Linkedin prospecting tool? Kaspr is the ideal fit, offering a highly practical, workflow-centric option.

Frequently Ask Questions

What does Kaspr specialise in?

Kasper is an expert in Linkedin-based contact enrichment. It helps users find verified business emails, mobile numbers, and prospect details on LinkedIn.

Does Kaspr work with Linkedin Sales Navigator?

Yes, Kaspr can be integrated with Linkedin Sales Navigator.

Is Kaspr suitable for enterprise companies?

Enterprise organizations can use Kasper for prospecting workflows.

Does Kaspr offer API access?

Yes, Kaspr gives a developer REST API.

What CRMs integrate with Kaspr?

Kasper can integrate with leading global CRMs. Some of them include HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, etc.
